item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a narrow beam of light meeting Aarav's polished steel plate. A dull cardboard sheet is also nearby.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: The polished steel plate changes the direction of the beam by reflection.
options.B: The beam bends toward the wall even if it passes beside the steel plate without hitting it.
options.C: A polished steel plate can reflect light; reflection is not limited to glass mirrors.
options.D: No reflection can occur at the steel plate unless a bright spot already appears on another surface.
